ecommerce.db_desc: An online retail platform managing product catalog, customer orders, supplier relationships, and product reviews.

tables.customers: Registered buyers on the platform. Each customer can place multiple orders and leave product reviews.
tables.categories: Hierarchical product classification. A category with parent_id=NULL is a top-level (root) category; others are sub-categories.
tables.products: Items available for purchase. The price field is the retail (selling) price shown to customers.
tables.suppliers: Vendors that supply products to the platform.
tables.product_suppliers: Many-to-many mapping between products and their suppliers. supply_price is the wholesale cost paid to the supplier.
tables.orders: Customer purchase transactions. total_amount represents the total revenue value of the order.
tables.order_items: Individual line items within an order. Each row is one product in one order.
tables.reviews: Customer feedback on purchased products. rating is a satisfaction score from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).

columns.orders.status: Lifecycle stage of the order. Values: 'pending' (placed, not yet paid), 'paid' (payment confirmed), 'shipped' (dispatched to customer), 'cancelled' (abandoned or rejected).
columns.orders.total_amount: Total monetary value of the order, representing revenue from this transaction.
columns.categories.parent_id: References the parent category. NULL means this is a root (top-level) category with no parent.
columns.products.price: Retail selling price — the amount charged to the customer.
columns.product_suppliers.supply_price: Wholesale cost price — the amount paid to the supplier. The gross margin is price minus supply_price.
columns.order_items.unit_price: Price at which the product was sold in this order (may differ from current products.price if price changed).
columns.products.stock: Current inventory quantity available. stock=0 means the product is out of stock.

hr.db_desc: A human resources and payroll system managing employee information, organizational hierarchy, attendance, and salary records.

tables.departments: Organizational units within the company (e.g., Engineering, Sales, HR).
tables.positions: Job roles and seniority levels. The level field describes seniority: 'junior', 'mid', 'senior', or 'lead'.
tables.employees: Company staff members. salary is the contracted base salary. manager_id links to the employee's direct supervisor.
tables.attendance: Daily attendance log per employee. Tracks whether each employee was present, late, absent, or on leave.
tables.payroll: Monthly payroll records. net_pay is the take-home amount after deductions. period_month uses 'YYYY-MM' format.

columns.employees.manager_id: The employee's direct manager. NULL means this employee is at the top of the reporting hierarchy (e.g., CEO or department head) and reports to no one.
columns.employees.salary: The employee's contracted base salary in VND.
columns.employees.hire_date: The date the employee joined the company. Used to calculate tenure.
columns.attendance.status: Daily attendance status. Values: 'present' (worked full day), 'late' (arrived late), 'absent' (did not show up), 'leave' (approved leave day).
columns.payroll.net_pay: Take-home pay after all deductions — the actual amount transferred to the employee.
columns.payroll.base_salary: The base component of salary before bonuses or deductions are applied.
columns.payroll.bonus: Additional variable pay for the period (performance bonus, incentive, etc.).
columns.payroll.deductions: Total deductions for the period (taxes, insurance, disciplinary penalties, etc.).
columns.payroll.period_month: Payroll period in 'YYYY-MM' format, e.g. '2026-06' for June 2026.
columns.positions.level: Seniority tier of the position. Values: 'junior', 'mid', 'senior', 'lead'.

hospital.db_desc: A clinic management system tracking patients, doctors, departments, appointments, and prescriptions.

tables.departments: Clinical departments or wards in the hospital (e.g., Cardiology, Pediatrics, Emergency).
tables.doctors: Attending physicians. specialty describes the doctor's medical field.
tables.patients: Registered patients. dob is date of birth, used to calculate patient age.
tables.appointments: Scheduled or completed consultations between a patient and a doctor.
tables.prescriptions: Medications prescribed during an appointment. duration_days is the course length of treatment.

columns.appointments.status: Appointment lifecycle status. Values: 'scheduled' (upcoming, patient is under active care), 'completed' (visit finished), 'cancelled' (no-show or patient cancelled).
columns.appointments.reason: The chief complaint or reason for the visit, as stated by the patient.
columns.patients.dob: Date of birth. Used to derive patient age at time of appointment.
columns.prescriptions.duration_days: Prescribed course length in days — how long the patient should take the medication.
columns.prescriptions.medication_name: Name of the drug or treatment prescribed.
columns.doctors.specialty: The doctor's clinical specialty or medical field (e.g., 'Cardiology', 'General Practice').
columns.doctors.department_id: The ward or department the doctor belongs to.
